text: In order to judge of the inside of others, study your own; for men in general are very much alike; and though one has one prevailing passion, and another has another, yet their operations are much the same; and whatever engages or disgusts, pleases or offends you, in others will, 'mutatis mutandis', engage, disgust, please, or offend others, in you.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXI, to his son, London, May 22, Old Style 1749
